data.title: ZenaTech Secures C$270,000 in Energy-Sector Survey Contracts
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from ZenaTech, Inc. ( (ZENA) ).

ZenaTech is a technology company specializing in AI drone platforms, Drone as a Service (DaaS), enterprise SaaS and quantum computing solutions. On November 17, 2026, it said its DaaS business secured survey contracts with two established energy-sector customers, including C$270,000 under contract for plant construction, infrastructure development and plant-site inspection.

The customers were an established Canadian oil and gas producer and a major energy infrastructure company. ZenaTech’s network combines licensed surveying with drone mapping and centralized LiDAR processing, while the company currently operates almost 45 DaaS locations across the U.S., Canada, U.K., Ireland, UAE and Australia.

data.title: Wilton Resources Announces Proposed Private Placement
data.description:
Wilton Resources ( (TSE:WIL) ) has provided an announcement.

Wilton Resources Inc. is listed on the TSXV, and the proposed financing would include a reserve to pursue an international oil and gas property acquisition; the release does not identify primary products or services. The company announced a non-brokered private placement of up to 3,571,429 units at $0.14 each, for maximum gross proceeds of $500,000.

The proceeds are designated for general corporate purposes and as a reserve to pursue the acquisition. The financing remains subject to regulatory approvals, including TSXV approval, and the securities would carry a statutory hold period of four months plus one day from closing.

data.title: WestBond Reports Higher Six-Month Profit and Quarterly Sales
data.description:
Westbond ( (TSE:WBE) ) has shared an update.

WestBond Enterprises Corporation supplies air-laid napkins and parent rolls, including customized air-laid napkins for national restaurant chains and major American restaurant supply distributors. The release says demand in Canada remains high.

Net profit for the six months ended September 30, 2026, increased 22.3% to $333,057 from $272,340 a year earlier, while quarterly net profit was $38,032. Quarterly sales rose 3.5% to $2,999,811 from $2,898,064 in the quarter ended June 30, 2026, reflecting higher air-laid napkin and parent roll sales; the company said U.S. tariffs coincided with a drop in American sales.

data.title: Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory Faces Nasdaq Listing Compliance Review
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory ( (RMCF) ).

On November 24, 2026, Nasdaq notified Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory that its common stock had closed below the $1 minimum bid price for 30 consecutive business days, creating a 180-calendar-day compliance period through May 24, 2027. The notice had no immediate effect on listing or trading; compliance required a closing bid price of at least $1 for 10 consecutive business days, while a further compliance period and potential delisting were conditional.

Also on November 24, 2026, the company amended Interim Chief Executive Officer Allen C. Harper’s offer letter, extending his original six-month service term by an additional six months while continuing his annual base salary of $140,000. Harper received a $130,000 RSU grant calculated using the 20-day volume-weighted average stock price before the grant date, with vesting in six equal monthly installments beginning January 8, 2027, subject to continued service as interim CEO.

data.title: Court Orders Searches and Asset Freezes Involving FASA in Grupo Fictor Case
data.description:
An announcement from Fictor Alimentos SA ( (BR:FASA3) ) is now available.

FASA S.A. is a publicly held company under judicial reorganization.

The São Paulo court partially granted a precautionary measure involving Grupo Fictor’s judicial reorganization, ordering civil searches and seizures at 12 addresses, including FASA’s registered office; the searches were carried out on November 26, 2026. It also ordered the sequestration, attachment and freezing of assets and financial assets belonging to FASA, its wholly owned subsidiary, controlling shareholder and Chief Executive Officer, up to R$4,295,549,149.70. The company is evaluating the decision’s effects on its activities and reorganization proceedings with legal advisers.

data.title: Jujubee Announces PLN 585,357.14 Inventory Impairment Write-Down
data.description:
Jujubee S.A. ( (PL:JJB) ) has shared an update.

Jujubee S.A. announced that its Management Board adopted a resolution on inventory impairment write-downs totaling PLN 585,357.14. The write-down covers 50% of the inventory value for “Realpolitiks 2” and 100% for the “Słowianie” prototype, “Emerald Caravan” and “Gore Doctor” on Nintendo Switch.

The write-down mainly reflects revenue generated to date, delays in releasing some games on other platforms, a lack of development of certain titles in 2026 and decisions not to develop them in subsequent years. It will be recognized as other operating expenses and affect the Company’s reported financial result and inventory value.
